items.title: Pay for professional cleaning after move-out
items.quote: Please pay this amount within 14 days of receiving this letter.
items.computation: The 14-day period runs from the day the letter was received (anchor = receipt), not from a printed document date, because no date is printed anywhere on the letter. Neither the letter's own date nor the actual day it arrived is known, so the start of the period cannot be fixed and the 14-day count (§ 187 Abs. 1, § 188 Abs. 2 BGB) cannot be completed. If, for example, the letter were received on a given day D, the deadline would be D+14 days, shifted to the next business day if it fell on a Saturday, Sunday or NW public holiday (§ 193 BGB). Without D, no exact due_date can be given.

warnings: The letter carries no printed date at all, and the actual day it was received is not stated, so the 14-day payment deadline cannot be computed exactly; once the arrival date is known, add 14 days (shifted to the next business day if that falls on a weekend or NW public holiday).
The sender is the landlord/letting company, not a public authority, so the statutory 'deemed delivery' rules for authority letters do not apply here; only the actual day of receipt counts.

The letter asserts a cost of €240.00 for cleaning was 'agreed in your tenancy' without attaching an invoice from the cleaning company or a copy of the relevant tenancy clause; it is worth asking for the underlying invoice and checking the tenancy agreement's wording before paying.

The IBAN given (DE95 3705 0198 0005 5505 00) is a valid German IBAN, but a valid IBAN does not prove who owns the account; confirm the payee details via a known, independent contact channel before transferring money, especially since the deposit return is explicitly made conditional on this payment arriving.
